newsitem.title: USA: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-COLORADO BEATS WASHINGTON IN HOLIDAY BOWL.
newsitem.headline: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-COLORADO BEATS WASHINGTON IN HOLIDAY BOWL.

text.p: Koy Detmer threw for 371 yards and three touchdowns as eighth-ranked Colorado rallied from a 14-point defcit for a 33-21 victory over number 13 Washington in the Holiday Bowl on Monday.

Detmer, whose brother Ty quarterbacks the Philadelphia Eagles, was 25-for-45 as Colorado (10-2) won its fourth straight bowl game. Rick Neuheisel became just the fifth coach in Division I-A history to win 10 or more games in each of his first two seasons.

Corey Dillon ran for two touchdowns in the first quarter for Washington (9-3), which fell to 3-5-1 all-time against Colorado. Dillon gained 109 yards on 20 carries in the first half, but was limited to 31 yards on 10 rushes as the Huskies were shut out in the second half.
